title: Desk Rule — Which Unacknowledged Alarms Are Counted into a Missed Acknowledgement Credit
content:
# Desk Rule — Which Unacknowledged Alarms Are Counted into a Missed Acknowledgement Credit

**The rule.** Where the tier's acknowledgement target is thirty minutes or less and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one urgent alarm the records show with no acknowledgement, the alarms credited on the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans are the critical and the urgent alarms alike that the records show with no acknowledgement. Where the tier's acknowledgement target is longer than thirty minutes and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one urgent alarm the records show with no acknowledgement, the alarms credited are the critical alarms with no acknowledgement together with half the urgent ones, taken down to a whole alarm. In every other case the alarms credited are the critical alarms the records show with no acknowledgement in the twelve months to the handling day.

| Tier's acknowledgement target | Urgent alarms with no acknowledgement in the twelve months | Alarms credited |
|---|---|---|
| 30 minutes or less | at least 1 | the critical and the urgent alarms alike that the records show with no acknowledgement |
| longer than 30 minutes | at least 1 | the critical ones with no acknowledgement together with half the urgent ones, taken down to a whole alarm |
| any | none | the critical alarms with no acknowledgement |

## Points of judgement

- An acknowledgement target of exactly 30 minutes falls in the first row, the boundary being thirty minutes or less.
- Half the urgent ones is taken down to a whole alarm: 5 urgent alarms with no acknowledgement give 2, and 1 gives nil.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

A plan at a tier whose acknowledgement target is 20 minutes, showing 3 critical and 5 urgent alarms with no acknowledgement in the twelve months, credits 8 alarms. The same history at a tier whose target is 45 minutes credits 3 plus half of 5 taken down to a whole alarm, that is 3 plus 2, so 5 alarms. With no urgent alarm unacknowledged, it credits the 3 critical ones.
